items.title: Costco (COST) Debuts Reusable Tote Trio In West Coast Stores And Online Soon
items.summary: Costco Wholesale (NasdaqGS:COST) is rolling out Out Of The Woods LLC's XL Tote Trio reusable bag set in select West Coast warehouses, with online availability expected soon. The XL Tote Trio features environmentally focused materials and design, reflecting Costco's wider push into sustainable consumer lifestyle products. This launch adds a new category of eco-friendly, reusable totes to Costco's in-warehouse assortment, separate from recent supplement and snack product launches. Investors...
